plan.title: Service PR to split RFQ award and PO

steps.note: Enable partial awarding required for splitting the service PR across vendors.
Enable RFx project creation from the purchase requisition.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.

args.goal: set the evaluation duration to 30 minutes and add one Required T&C clause on the event create screen, then leave the create screen showing the saved configuration

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated controls for evaluation duration or adding a required T&C clause, but both are buyer-side actions expressible in the current screen.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors without inventing their company names.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Verify publication reached a real project page.
Have the first invited vendor submit its portal quote at 100 per activity.
Verify the first vendor's quote was submitted.
Have the second invited vendor submit its portal quote at 90 per activity.
Verify the second vendor's quote was submitted.
Wait for the bidding window to end before comparing or awarding.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
The second portal bidder is Vendor B by bid order, so assert that bidder is ranked first.
Enter the award allocation screen.
Allocate the first service activity to the first available vendor.
Allocate the remaining service activity to the other available vendor.
Verify both activities are allocated across two vendors.
Create the proposal after the split allocation.
Verify the proposal screen offers submission.
Submit the award proposal for approval.
Create purchase orders after the award is approved.
Verify the resulting purchase orders contain the two awarded service activities.
Return to the events list to check the event's post-award history presence.
Open the History tab after award and PO creation.
Verify this plan's event appears in event history.
